people.name: Elijah
people.line: A prophet during the reigns of Ahab and Ahaziah.

translations.web: Yahweh listened to the voice of Elijah; and the soul of the child came into him again, and he revived.
translations.bsb: And the LORD listened to the voice of Elijah, and the child’s life returned to him, and he lived.
